import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read the provided data
df = pd.read_csv('/mnt/uploads/weather.csv')

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 6))

# Convert precipitation to visible marker areas; provide a legend for those sizes.
size_scale = 100
sizes = df['precip_mm'] * size_scale
scatter = ax.scatter(df['temp_c'], df['aqi'], s=sizes, alpha=0.7, edgecolors='black')

# Legend handles communicate the mapping from precipitation to marker area.
precip_values = sorted(df['precip_mm'].unique())
handles = [ax.scatter([], [], s=value * size_scale, alpha=0.7, edgecolors='black', label=f'{value:g} mm') for value in precip_values]
ax.legend(handles=handles, title='Precipitation')

ax.set_ylabel('AQI')
ax.set_title('Temperature vs AQI (point size = precipitation)')
ax.set_xlim(0, df['temp_c'].max() * 1.1)
ax.set_ylim(0, df['aqi'].max() * 1.1)
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.25)
fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()
